title: Provision SNS Topic
scenario: Your platform team needs SNS Topic for a pub/sub fan-out topic. Write a reusable Terraform configuration that provisions it, drives every input through variables, applies the standard tags, and exports the operational identifiers.
constraints: Create exactly one resource of type aws_sns_topic.
All configurable values must come from variables declared in variables.tf.
Code must pass terraform fmt conventions (2-space indents, trailing newline, no tabs).
Tag the resource with Project, Environment and ManagedBy = "terraform".

focus.title: Complete the aws_sns_topic resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_sns_topic.

hints.why: Topics provide fan-out messaging. Subscriptions decide who receives events and in what format.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_sns_topic" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_sns_topic. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use SNS when one event should notify several consumers or when you need a simple pub/sub boundary.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_sns_topic" "this"`. Use this code shape: name; tags; fifo_topic. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.topic_name`, `var.project_name`, `var.environment`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
